# Dunmore Works

Site profile, revision 1.

Maintenance crews inspect the containment and the power electronics on a quarterly schedule. Insurance terms were negotiated after a review of fire suppression and thermal monitoring. Degradation is tracked with a monthly capacity test at a fixed state of charge. A community fund receives a small share of the revenue from frequency regulation services. Spare parts are held on site to keep repair times short during the winter months.

- Technology: vanadium flow

- Storage capacity: 345 MWh

- Round-trip efficiency: 90%

- Commissioned: 2027
